features.name: Bank Account Reconciliation Assistance with Copilot
features.description: A new copilot capability that assists users in reconciling bank account statements by matching imported bank transactions with business central ledger entries. Copilot uses large language models to interpret ambiguity, understand intent, and match lines that the built-in algorithm cannot automatically match. The feature learns from reconciliation mappings and improves future suggestions.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is now available in public preview with 2023 release Wave 2
caveats: Only available for Business Central online (SaaS)
Copilot performs better with English language transactions
Performance may be reduced with mixed language transactions
Will be delivered in a minor update spanning November 2023 to March 2024
Not restricted by country localizations but may perform differently
Suggestions might not perform as well in other languages

features.name: Reconcile with Copilot Action
features.description: A new action on the bank account reconciliations list that launches a copilot-tailored dialogue for the reconciliation process. The dialogue allows users to select a bank account, import transaction data from a file or online bank feed, and generate matching proposals.
caveats: Requires bank statement import setup on the account
All proposals are provisional until explicitly saved

features.name: Hybrid Matching Algorithm
features.description: The system first attempts to match statement lines using the built-in business central matching algorithm, then sends unmatched lines to copilot for additional matching. Copilot can match lines to multiple ledger entries when appropriate.

features.name: Transfer to GL Account with Semantic Matching
features.description: Users can transfer unmatched bank statement lines to general ledger accounts. Copilot analyzes line descriptions and GL account names to suggest appropriate accounts, using semantic understanding rather than substring matching. Users can manually override suggestions and save description-to-account mappings for future use.
caveats: Mappings saved are specific to the reconciliation context

features.name: Visual Reconciliation Progress Indicator
features.description: A visual indicator on the reconciliation page shows how many of the statement lines have been matched by copilot and the built-in algorithm, helping users quickly assess reconciliation completeness.

features.name: Auto-Post If Fully Applied
features.description: When all statement lines are matched, users can check a box to automatically post the bank account reconciliation without additional review, streamlining the process for complete reconciliations.
caveats: Only available when all lines are matched

features.name: Description-to-Account Mapping
features.description: Users can save mappings between bank statement line descriptions and general ledger accounts. These mappings persist in the database and are reused in future reconciliations to improve matching consistency.
caveats: Savings are based on manual user selection

features.name: Copilot and AI Capabilities Page
features.description: Admin page that provides an overview of all copilot and AI capabilities installed in a specific environment. Shows which capabilities are active and indicates if the environment is connected to Azure OpenAI service.

features.name: Feature Management for Bank Account Reconciliation
features.description: Administrators must enable the bank account reconciliation feature via the feature management page. Required when upgrading from earlier versions of Business Central. Requires elevated admin permissions.
caveats: Only needed when upgrading from earlier versions

features.name: Azure OpenAI Regional Configuration
features.description: Administrators can configure whether Business Central can connect to Azure OpenAI service in different regions. A switch allows administrators to give consent for data movement to connect to Azure OpenAI in regions where it is available.
caveats: Required only if environment localization is in a region where Azure OpenAI service is not available

features.name: Copilot Feedback Rating
features.description: Users can rate and signal feedback on the quality of copilot suggestions during bank account reconciliation. Feedback is collected to improve the feature.

features.name: Developer Tools for Copilot
features.description: New developer tools available for building generative AI capabilities in Business Central extensions. Bank reconciliation assistance was built using these tools, enabling partners to design and implement similar AI capabilities.
